body:
An agent exited during discussion in such a way that "Needs attention" flag appeared with an error:

agent exited without finishing (exit status: 0):

…a: a task store the board writes, fed by messages.

Wanted: board changes that only touch tasks no longer take the project lock; an agent's run records and task notes go through the board; messages are saved before they're confirmed; a repeated create makes only one task.
Done when: tests show create, note and stop going through while a command runs; a double-clicked create makes one task; the existing board and workspace acceptance tests still pass.
Also needs: a new decision record.
Your follow-up: commands are locked because Solace can't tell in advance whether they'll change code. I recommended not making the gap. If you want relief before the task store exists, one option is marking a command as one that doesn't write code (for example writes = false) so it runs without the lock. The other is splitting the board's lock from the code lock.
Still open: whether to fold this task into the task-store task or keep it for the writes = false stopgap.
title: Fix: Agent error
